answer_page.gloss_en: To stop sleeping; to awake.

examples.example_en: I wake up at seven every day.

answer_page.usage_note: 不及物 wake up 表示醒来；wake somebody up 表示叫醒别人。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: 不及物 wake up 表示醒来；wake somebody up 表示叫醒别人。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To stop sleeping; to awake.

answer_page.gloss_en: To rise from one's bed, usually upon waking up in order to begin one's day.

examples.example_en: I get up after my alarm rings.

answer_page.usage_note: get up 表示从床上起来，不一定与 wake up 同时发生。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: get up 表示从床上起来，不一定与 wake up 同时发生。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To rise from one's bed, usually upon waking up in order to begin one's day.

answer_page.gloss_en: To not sleep, to stay awake. (This entry is a translation hub.)

examples.example_en: I am still awake at midnight.

answer_page.usage_note: be awake 描述醒着的状态。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: be awake 描述醒着的状态。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To not sleep, to stay awake. (This entry is a translation hub.)

answer_page.gloss_en: To pass from a state of wakefulness into sleep.

examples.example_en: I fell asleep during the movie.

answer_page.usage_note: fall asleep 表示由清醒进入睡眠的变化。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: fall asleep 表示由清醒进入睡眠的变化。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To pass from a state of wakefulness into sleep.

answer_page.gloss_en: To fall asleep slowly.

examples.example_en: She drifted off on the sofa.
examples.example_zh: 她在沙发上渐渐睡着了。

answer_page.usage_note: drift off 强调慢慢入睡，也有走神的其他义项。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: drift off 强调慢慢入睡，也有走神的其他义项。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To fall asleep slowly.

answer_page.gloss_en: To fall asleep unintentionally.

examples.example_en: He dozed off on the train.
examples.example_zh: 他在火车上不知不觉打起了瞌睡。

answer_page.usage_note: doze off 通常强调短暂、不经意地睡着。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: doze off 通常强调短暂、不经意地睡着。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To fall asleep unintentionally.

answer_page.gloss_en: To sleep late; to go on sleeping past one's customary or planned hour.

examples.example_en: I like to sleep in on Sundays.

answer_page.usage_note: sleep in 表示比惯常起床时间晚些起床。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: sleep in 表示比惯常起床时间晚些起床。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To sleep late; to go on sleeping past one's customary or planned hour.

answer_page.gloss_en: To stay in bed (longer than usual).

examples.example_en: We had a lie-in on Saturday.
examples.example_zh: 星期六我们睡了个懒觉。

answer_page.usage_note: lie in 在此是英式用法；与分娩相关的旧义不同。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: lie in 在此是英式用法；与分娩相关的旧义不同。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To stay in bed (longer than usual).

answer_page.gloss_en: To sleep for longer than intended.

examples.example_en: I overslept and missed the bus.
examples.example_zh: 我睡过了头，错过了公交车。

answer_page.usage_note: oversleep 指睡得比原计划久。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: oversleep 指睡得比原计划久。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To sleep for longer than intended.

answer_page.gloss_en: To sleep, especially briefly; to nap, doze.

examples.example_en: I snoozed for ten more minutes.

answer_page.usage_note: snooze 可作动词，表示短暂打盹；不要与闹钟延后按钮义混淆。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: snooze 可作动词，表示短暂打盹；不要与闹钟延后按钮义混淆。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To sleep, especially briefly; to nap, doze.

answer_page.gloss_en: To be unable to settle into a comfortable sleeping position.

examples.example_en: I tossed and turned all night.

answer_page.usage_note: toss and turn 常用于描述睡不安稳、不断翻身。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: toss and turn 常用于描述睡不安稳、不断翻身。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To be unable to settle into a comfortable sleeping position.

answer_page.gloss_en: Having had sufficient (or even more than enough) sleep or rest to function optimally during waking hours.

examples.example_en: I feel well-rested today.
examples.example_zh: 今天我感觉休息得很充分。

answer_page.usage_note: well-rested 形容休息充足的状态。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: well-rested 形容休息充足的状态。

source_evidence.native_gloss: Having had sufficient (or even more than enough) sleep or rest to function optimally during waking hours.

answer_page.gloss_en: Being kept awake to the point of noticeably lower alertness through a lack of sleep; experiencing sleep deprivation.

examples.example_en: Sleep-deprived workers may struggle to focus.
examples.example_zh: 睡眠不足的工作人员可能难以集中注意力。

answer_page.usage_note: sleep-deprived 指因缺乏睡眠而受到影响。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: sleep-deprived 指因缺乏睡眠而受到影响。

source_evidence.native_gloss: Being kept awake to the point of noticeably lower alertness through a lack of sleep; experiencing sleep deprivation.

answer_page.gloss_en: Tired; feeling the need for sleep.

examples.example_en: I feel sleepy after lunch.

answer_page.usage_note: sleepy 在此表示想睡觉，而不是让人发困的事物。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: sleepy 在此表示想睡觉，而不是让人发困的事物。

source_evidence.native_gloss: Tired; feeling the need for sleep.

answer_page.gloss_en: Showing signs of being asleep or very sleepy, as not demonstrating full energy or attention.

examples.example_en: She was half-asleep when the phone rang.
examples.example_zh: 电话响时她正半睡半醒。

answer_page.usage_note: half-asleep 表示注意力不充分、近乎睡着。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: half-asleep 表示注意力不充分、近乎睡着。

source_evidence.native_gloss: Showing signs of being asleep or very sleepy, as not demonstrating full energy or attention.

answer_page.gloss_en: Awake and very alert; vigilant, watchful.

examples.example_en: After the nap I was wide awake.

answer_page.usage_note: wide awake 强调非常清醒、警觉。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: wide awake 强调非常清醒、警觉。

source_evidence.native_gloss: Awake and very alert; vigilant, watchful.

answer_page.gloss_en: A person who wakes up, without difficulty, early each morning and is alert and active during the first part of the day.

examples.example_en: My sister is a morning person.

answer_page.usage_note: morning person 指早晨精力较好的人。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: morning person 指早晨精力较好的人。

source_evidence.native_gloss: A person who wakes up, without difficulty, early each morning and is alert and active during the first part of the day.

answer_page.gloss_en: One who goes to bed late, or stays up late at night or in the early hours of the morning.

examples.example_en: I am a night owl and work best late.
examples.example_zh: 我是夜猫子，深夜工作效率最高。

answer_page.usage_note: night owl 在此指夜间活动或很晚入睡的人，不是鸟类本义。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: night owl 在此指夜间活动或很晚入睡的人，不是鸟类本义。

source_evidence.native_gloss: One who goes to bed late, or stays up late at night or in the early hours of the morning.

answer_page.gloss_en: A pattern of sleeping and waking; especially a regular pattern of sleeping and waking designed to promote health.

examples.example_en: I am trying to keep a regular sleep schedule.
examples.example_zh: 我正努力保持规律的作息时间。

answer_page.usage_note: sleep schedule 表示睡眠和醒来的时间安排。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: sleep schedule 表示睡眠和醒来的时间安排。

source_evidence.native_gloss: A pattern of sleeping and waking; especially a regular pattern of sleeping and waking designed to promote health.

answer_page.gloss_en: A biological clock.

examples.example_en: Jet lag can affect your body clock.
examples.example_zh: 时差反应可能影响你的生物钟。

answer_page.usage_note: body clock 指生物节律机制。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: body clock 指生物节律机制。

source_evidence.native_gloss: A biological clock.

answer_page.gloss_en: A clock designed to sound an alert at a preset time, primarily to wake someone from sleep.

examples.example_en: My alarm clock rings at six.

answer_page.usage_note: alarm clock 指设定时间发出提醒的钟。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: alarm clock 指设定时间发出提醒的钟。

source_evidence.native_gloss: A clock designed to sound an alert at a preset time, primarily to wake someone from sleep.

answer_page.gloss_en: A button on an alarm clock which, when pressed, silences the alarm temporarily, granting a few more minutes of sleep before the alarm sounds again.

examples.example_en: I pressed the snooze button twice.

answer_page.usage_note: snooze button 用于短暂推迟闹铃。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: snooze button 用于短暂推迟闹铃。

source_evidence.native_gloss: A button on an alarm clock which, when pressed, silences the alarm temporarily, granting a few more minutes of sleep before the alarm sounds again.

answer_page.gloss_en: A telephone call to awaken someone at a certain time, especially one requested by the person while staying at a hotel.

examples.example_en: Please arrange a wake-up call for seven.
examples.example_zh: 请安排七点的叫醒电话。

answer_page.usage_note: wake-up call 在此指叫醒服务，而非警醒事件的比喻义。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: wake-up call 在此指叫醒服务，而非警醒事件的比喻义。

source_evidence.native_gloss: A telephone call to awaken someone at a certain time, especially one requested by the person while staying at a hotel.

answer_page.gloss_en: The early part of the day, especially from midnight to noon.

examples.example_en: I go for a walk every morning.

answer_page.usage_note: morning 在此指一天较早的时段。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: morning 在此指一天较早的时段。

source_evidence.native_gloss: The early part of the day, especially from midnight to noon.

answer_page.gloss_en: The morning twilight period immediately before sunrise.

examples.example_en: We left home at dawn.

answer_page.usage_note: dawn 在此指日出前的晨曦时段。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: dawn 在此指日出前的晨曦时段。

source_evidence.native_gloss: The morning twilight period immediately before sunrise.

answer_page.gloss_en: The beginning of the day; the first moment of daylight.

examples.example_en: The birds began singing at daybreak.
examples.example_zh: 天刚亮时鸟儿开始歌唱。

answer_page.usage_note: daybreak 指一天刚开始、天亮的时刻。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: daybreak 指一天刚开始、天亮的时刻。

source_evidence.native_gloss: The beginning of the day; the first moment of daylight.

answer_page.gloss_en: The time of day when the sun appears above the eastern horizon.

examples.example_en: We watched the sunrise on the beach.

answer_page.usage_note: sunrise 表示太阳从地平线上升起的时间或景象。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: sunrise 表示太阳从地平线上升起的时间或景象。

source_evidence.native_gloss: The time of day when the sun appears above the eastern horizon.

answer_page.gloss_en: Punctually or according to the schedule.

examples.example_en: The train arrived on time.

answer_page.usage_note: on time 表示按照计划时间，不等同于 in time（及时赶上）。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: on time 表示按照计划时间，不等同于 in time（及时赶上）。

source_evidence.native_gloss: Punctually or according to the schedule.

answer_page.gloss_en: Prior to a deadline.

examples.example_en: We finished the project ahead of schedule.

answer_page.usage_note: ahead of schedule 表示比计划时间更早。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: ahead of schedule 表示比计划时间更早。

source_evidence.native_gloss: Prior to a deadline.

answer_page.gloss_en: Rushed, hurried; short of time.

examples.example_en: I left home in a hurry.

answer_page.usage_note: in a hurry 表示匆忙、赶时间。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: in a hurry 表示匆忙、赶时间。

source_evidence.native_gloss: Rushed, hurried; short of time.

answer_page.gloss_en: To hurry; to increase the speed of doing something.

examples.example_en: Hurry up or we will be late.
examples.example_zh: 快一点，否则我们会迟到。

answer_page.usage_note: hurry up 常用于催促行动加快。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: hurry up 常用于催促行动加快。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To hurry; to increase the speed of doing something.

answer_page.gloss_en: A day of vacation; a day when one does not go to work, school, etc.

examples.example_en: I have a day off on Friday.

answer_page.usage_note: day off 指不用工作或上学的一天。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: day off 指不用工作或上学的一天。

source_evidence.native_gloss: A day of vacation; a day when one does not go to work, school, etc.

answer_page.gloss_en: To assume a sitting position from a position lying down.

examples.example_en: I sat up when I heard the noise.
examples.example_zh: 听到响声时我从躺姿坐了起来。

answer_page.usage_note: sit up 指由躺着转为坐姿，不是仰卧起坐运动名词。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: sit up 指由躺着转为坐姿，不是仰卧起坐运动名词。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To assume a sitting position from a position lying down.

answer_page.gloss_en: To rise from a lying or sitting position.

examples.example_en: Please stand up when your name is called.
examples.example_zh: 叫到你的名字时请站起来。

answer_page.usage_note: stand up 在此指从坐姿或躺姿站起。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: stand up 在此指从坐姿或躺姿站起。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To rise from a lying or sitting position.

answer_page.gloss_en: To remove.

examples.example_en: Please take off your shoes at the door.

answer_page.usage_note: take off 在此指脱下衣物或鞋子；不能用 put on 的音标。

sense_disambiguation.note_zh: take off 在此指脱下衣物或鞋子；不能用 put on 的音标。

source_evidence.native_gloss: To remove.
